framing: These dimensions, severities and status thresholds are project-specific evaluation choices for this MVP, informed by the MQM framework's general concepts of selecting an error taxonomy and assigning severity. This project evaluates same-language locale-conditioned generation, not translation, so results are described as MQM-informed, not MQM-compliant.

dimensions.name: Factual accuracy
dimensions.description: The output preserves the facts supplied in the task brief (prices, dates, offer conditions, product details) without inventing, altering or dropping them.

dimensions.name: Instruction & constraint compliance
dimensions.description: The output satisfies the task's explicit constraints, such as required mentions, length limits or format.

dimensions.name: Locale conventions
dimensions.description: The output follows the spelling, date, currency and measurement conventions expected for the target locale.

dimensions.name: Terminology & approved brand wording
dimensions.description: The output uses everyday terminology consistent with the locale and, where a brand glossary entry applies, the approved brand wording.

subtypes.name: Incorrect or missing approved brand wording

dimensions.name: Style & brand voice
dimensions.description: The tone and register are consistent with concise marketing copy and are not jarring, inconsistent or unnatural for the locale.

minor.description: A small deviation that a reader would likely overlook or that does not materially affect the copy's usefulness.

major.description: A deviation a locale-aware reader or brand reviewer would likely flag and want corrected before publication.

critical.description: A deviation serious enough on its own to block publication, such as a factual error or a violated hard constraint.

status_policy.description: Status is derived from the sum of annotation points for a single assessment. If any annotation in that assessment is critical severity, status is Fail regardless of total points. Otherwise the total falls into one band below.
